title: TAMIU earns Bronze Veterans Education Excellence award, a first in university history
excerpt: Texas A&M International University has earned the Bronze Veterans Education Excellence Recognition Award from the Texas Veterans Commission — the first time in the university's history it has received the distinction.
content:
Texas A&M International University has been awarded the Bronze Veterans Education Excellence Recognition Award by the Texas Veterans Commission, the first time in university history that TAMIU has earned the distinction, the university announced November 6.

The recognition honors institutions that demonstrate a strong commitment to providing educational services, resources and support to veterans and members of the military-connected community.

University President Dr. Christopher Maynard called the recognition an important milestone that reflects TAMIU's commitment to making sure veterans and military-connected students have the support they need to succeed.

University Registrar Triana Valdez, who oversees the Office of Veterans Affairs, led the university's pursuit of the recognition. Vice President of Enrollment Management Juan García credited Valdez's leadership and the hard work of the Veterans Affairs team.

The Office of Veterans Affairs helps veteran and military-connected students navigate the educational benefits and resources available to them as they pursue their academic goals.

Veterans interested in continuing their education at TAMIU can learn more about the office's services at tamiu.edu/veterans, by emailing veterans@tamiu.edu, calling 956.326.2251, or visiting the Senator Judith Zaffirini Student Success Center, room 121K.

Source: Texas A&M International University, November 6, 2026.
